title: PUT is a full replace, not a partial update
evidence: main.go:167 UPDATE sets all columns; a request omitting year/isbn clears them
suggestion: Acceptable per spec ('updates a book'); documented in README and agent summary. Consider PATCH semantics if partial updates are desired.

title: ?author= filter is exact full-name match, not substring
suggestion: Meets R3 (case-insensitive full-name filter, tested in TestListAuthorFilter). Substring/LIKE matching would be a UX improvement, not required.

title: Tests exercise only in-memory SQLite, not the file-backed path
evidence: main_test.go:12 OpenDB(":memory:"); file-backed DB_PATH path in main.go:198 is untested
suggestion: R7 satisfied — production uses modernc.org/sqlite with DB_PATH. A test opening a temp-file DB would cover persistence across connections.
